description: Source code for quantized reduction operations (mean and std) in PyTorch, including fast paths and QNNPACK support.

methods.name: is_innnermost_dim
methods.description: Checks if the specified dimensions are the innermost dimensions of the tensor.

methods.name: is_mean_inner_dim_fast_path
methods.description: Determines if the fast path for mean calculation can be used based on tensor dimensions and dtype.

methods.name: qnnpack_mean
methods.description: Performs mean calculation using QNNPACK for 4D quantized tensors.

methods.name: mean_out_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Computes the mean of a quantized tensor, with support for fast path and QNNPACK.

methods.name: mean_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Wrapper for mean_out_quantized_cpu that returns the result tensor.

methods.name: is_std_inner_dim_fast_path
methods.description: Checks if the fast path for std calculation can be used based on tensor dimensions and correction.

methods.name: std_out_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Computes the standard deviation of a quantized tensor, with support for fast path.

methods.name: std_quantized_cpu
methods.description: Wrapper for std_out_quantized_cpu that returns the result tensor.
